Name: Lance's Children
Author: StardewStardude
TagLine: Stardew Valley Expanded now has children sprites for Lance and the farmer!
Description:
A portrait for two children with Lance and the Farmer from SDVE. Designed to be placed in the Lance folder that SDVE and Child to NPC needs, otherwise the children the farmer has with the farmer will always use randomised adopted sprites instead. Can be used with Unique children, and Unique children talk also.

There is now sprites for the son, daughter and babies ones, found in the internal files of Stardew Valley.

It will work as long as you have SDVE and Child to NPC updated to the latest patch/unofficial update.

Downloads.Description: A portrait for the Children of Lance (SDVE) of the First Slash and the Farmer. There is one for a boy and girl, based on the sprite for Vincent and the extra child character, Eve. There is now sprites for the son, daughter and babies ones.

OtherFields.patchNotes: Added babies' sprites, edited one for a girl based on the boys' one.

OtherFields.notice:
Credits: Concerned ape for the bases of Vincent, and Jas. Girl portrait's hair is based loosely on Elliot/Leah's daughter Eve from Lifecycle by nraittanna, but hand-drawn in Clipstudio to match Lance, from Stardew Valley Expanded. 

Art for Lance in SDVE is by the co-creator Sugar_Wizard, from the SDVE Reddit and Wiki page.

Child bases available to download by Xiddav and Eros DKAI's mod, The Farmer's children. 

Works with SDVE, and Child to NPC.
